title: Fruit bar with net quantity printed as a bare number, no unit

blocks.text: Ingredients: Dates, Dried figs, Dried apricots, Rolled oats, Honey
Nutritional Information (per 100 g): Energy 320 kcal, Protein 4.5 g, Carbohydrate 68.0 g, Total Sugars 52.0 g, Total Fat 2.5 g, Sodium 15 mg
Manufactured by: Sunvalley Foods Pvt Ltd, 18 Orchard Estate, Solan 173212, Himachal Pradesh, India
Store in a cool dry place

notes: The front panel shows the number 250 prominently but no unit (g, ml, kg) appears anywhere near it or anywhere else on the pack. Deliberately ambiguous: it looks like a quantity declaration but is not a valid one without a unit. Rolled oats is a cereal containing gluten under FSSAI regulation 5(14)(i), a regulated allergen, so a Contains statement is required and is present here, keeping the case an isolated single violation of the net quantity rule only.
